Name: SummerFleur's Better Hats
Author: SummerFleur
Description:
[b][size=4]Description[/size][/b]

In the vanilla game, hats are often nothing more than expensive decorations. You spend hard-earned money or complete challenges to unlock them, only to find they serve no real purpose—a bit of a letdown, isn’t it? So I created this mod to give almost every hat a unique effect.

In this mod, the overall bonuses are simple and useful, but definitely not overpowered. I didn’t just pull numbers out of thin air—they are thoughtfully balanced. And they can be mainly divided into four main categories:

[list=1]
[*]Utility Buffs: Provides various powerful buffs to assist with daily chores and adventures.[/*]
[*]Mechanic Tweaks: Modifies game rules to offer unexpected conveniences or brand-new gameplay styles.[/*]
[*]Social Interactions: Wearing specific hats unlocks unique dialogue with marriageable villagers and grants extra friendship points.[/*]
[*]Just for Fun: Purely for fun, adding a touch of humor and surprise to your farm life.[/*]
[/list]
Hope this mod brings a fresh and colorful experience to your time in Stardew Valley!

[b][size=4]Sample Of The Hat Effects[/size][/b]

[list]
[*][b]Sailor's Cap[/b]: Fishing +1[/*]
[*][b]Golden Mask[/b]: Deals ×1.5 damage to Serpents and Iridium Bats.[/*]
[*][b]Lucky Bow[/b]: Daily Luck +0.015[/*]
[*][b]Garbage Hat[/b]: Increases the chance of finding items in Garbage Cans by 10%[/*]
[*][b]Totem Mask[/b]: An active effect to warp home. Once per day[/*]
[*][b]Space Helmet[/b]: Attack Multiplier +10%, Defense +2, Speed +0.5 (while in the Dangerous Mines or Skull Cavern, the more dangerous the mine, the higher the bonus)[/*]
[/list]
[b][size=4]Help[/size][/b]

[list]
[*]This mod requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41439]Better Hats API (BHA)[/url], and BHA provides a comprehensive guide book menu that can show all the effect of hats in one area, so if you want know more about the effect of hats, just press the hot key (By default is [font=Courier New]Ctrl + Alt + H[/font]), and you can see them in the menu conveniently.[/*]
[*]SVE is not required actually, but some of the unique dialogues are designed for SVE NPCs.[/*]
[*]This mod is compatible with Deluxe Hats and Skillful Clothes Revamp in theory. But I didn't make a wide-range test to those mods, if you find a bug, please report it on the [url=https://github.com/SummerFleur2997/StardewMods/issues]Github issue tracker[/url]﻿ and I'll try my best to fix them. Please avoid leave comments at nexus because I don't check it often.[/*]
[/list]
[b][size=4]Translation[/size][/b]

This mod supports native i18n provided by the SMAPI. Contributions are welcome, you can commit your translation on [url=https://github.com/SummerFleur2997/StardewMods#translating-the-mods]Github[/url], or directly upload them on nexus. English is not my first language, so for native English users, if you want to improve the current English translation, you can also come and help!

[b][size=4]Install[/size][/b]

[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI[/*]
[/list]

[b][size=4]模组简介[/size][/b]

在星露谷的原版游戏中，帽子往往只是昂贵的装饰品——解锁成就后购买它们，除了作为一个装饰品以外，就别无他用，这似乎有些鸡肋了。因此我制作了这个模组，为游戏中几乎所有的帽子新增了独一无二的功能和效果。

在本模组中，各种帽子给予的效果和数值都是经过设计的——简单实用而不超模，绝对没有“用脚填的数值”，他们大致可以分为四大类：

[list=1]
[*]实用增益：提供各种各样的 Buff，助力你的 627 生活。[/*]
[*]机制改变：修改游戏机制，带来意想不到的便利或全新玩法。[/*]
[*]社交互动：佩戴特定帽子与可结婚的村民聊天，可以触发特殊的对话，并获得额外的友谊值。[/*]
[*]趣味整活：纯粹为了整活儿，为生活增添一丝幽默与惊喜。[/*]
[/list]
希望这个模组能让你的星露谷之旅更加丰富多彩，享受每一顶帽子带来的乐趣！

[b][size=4]部分帽子效果示例[/size][/b]

[list]
[*][b]水手帽[/b]：钓鱼 +1[/*]
[*][b]金色面具[/b]：对飞蛇和铱蝠的伤害 ×1.5[/*]
[*][b]幸运蝴蝶结[/b]：每日运气 +0.015[/*]
[*][b]垃圾帽[/b]：在垃圾桶中发现东西的概率 +10%[/*]
[*][b]图腾面具[/b]: 主动效果 - 传送回家，每天一次[/*]
[*][b]太空头盔[/b]：伤害倍率 +10%, 防御+2, 速度+0.5 (在危险矿井或骷髅洞穴中时获得加成，矿井越危险，加成越高)[/*]
[/list]
[b][size=4]帮助[/size][/b]

[list]
[*]本模组需要 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41439]Better Hats API (BHA)[/url] 作为前置，而 BHA 提供了一个方便强大的帽子图鉴菜单，你可以在这个菜单里了解所有帽子的效果及其详细描述（菜单快捷键默认为 [font=Courier New]Ctrl + Alt + H[/font]）[/*]
[*]SVE 并不是必须的，但部分帽子的特殊对话是为 SVE 的角色设计的。[/*]
[/list]
本模组理论上兼容 Deluxe Hats 和 Skillful Clothes Revamp 但是我还没有进行大范围的兼容性测试，因此若你发现了 bug，请前往 [url=https://github.com/SummerFleur2997/StardewMods/issues]Github Issue[/url]﻿﻿﻿﻿ 处留言，我会修复它们。尽量不要在 Nexus 上评论（因为不常看）。

[b][size=4]安装并使用此 Mod[/size][/b]

[list]
[*]请先安装[url=https://smapi.io]最新版本的 SMAPI[/url]﻿；[/*]
[*]将此 Mod 下载解压至 Mods 文件夹；[/*]
[*]使用 SMAPI 启动游戏[/*]
[/list]
[b][size=4]发现 Bug 了吗？ O.o[/size][/b]

请在 [url=https://github.com/SummerFleur2997/StardewMods/issues]Github Issue[/url]﻿﻿﻿﻿ 处留言，尽量不要在 Nexus 上评论（因为不常看）。
